path_denied: This tool path is outside the project or is a protected credential directory.
tool_denied: This tool is unavailable in this engine.
permission_unsupported: Full system access is not supported by this Claude Code adapter.
unsupported: This engine does not support this action.
model_mismatch: The engine selected an unexpected model.
timeout: The turn exceeded its time limit.
approval_denied: The requested file change was not approved.
limitations: Claude Code supports project file tools. Arbitrary shell commands, active steering, MCP configuration and skills management are unavailable in this adapter.
queue_invalid: The queued message is unavailable or the order is invalid.
persist: Could not save the engine state.
idle_timeout: The engine stopped responding. The partial turn was preserved.
interrupt_timeout: The engine has not confirmed that it stopped. This chat remains locked until its turn ends.
